chunks: Indeed, Quraysh demolished the Kaaba because the flood used to come to them from the upper part of Mecca, then enter it, so it cracked.

key_terms.أَعْلَى: The upper region or elevated part from which the water came
key_terms.السَّيْلَ: Floodwater or torrent that caused structural damage
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةَ: The Sacred House in Mecca central to hajj and worship
key_terms.فَانْصَدَعَتْ: It cracked or split due to the damage
key_terms.قُرَيْشٌ: The tribe of Quraysh, custodians of the Kaaba in Mecca
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the sacred city containing the Kaaba

ai.seo_question: Why did Quraysh demolish the Kaaba before rebuilding it?
ai.summary: This report explains a historical reason why Quraysh demolished the Kaaba: floodwaters descended from the higher part of Mecca and entered the structure, causing damage. Its significance lies in preserving the background of the Kaaba’s reconstruction in the context of hajj history.
